questions.question_text: Vach.Sā.2 pramāṇe, 'Vachane karīne to jīvprāṇīmātrane _______ nahī.'
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, 'Vachane karīne to jīvprāṇīmātrane dukhavvā nahī,' meaning 'one should not distress all living beings with words.'
As per Vach.Sā.2, the instruction is 'Vachane karīne to jīvprāṇīmātrane dukhavvā nahī,' referring to 'all living beings'.

questions.question_text: Vach.Sā.2 pramāṇe, vachane karīne jīvprāṇīmātrane shuṃ nahī karavuṃ?
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut clearly states, 'Vachane karīne to jīvprāṇīmātrane dukhavvā nahī,' meaning one should not 'distress' with words.

questions.question_text: Kayā Vachanamrutmā એમ kahevāmāṃ āvyuṃ che ke 'Vachane karīne to jīvprāṇīmātrane dukhavvā nahī'?
questions.explanation: The statement 'Vachane karīne to jīvprāṇīmātrane dukhavvā nahī' is found in Vach.Sā.2.
